page.overview:
Who is The Brachiosaurus?

The Brachiosaurus was the first dinosaur encountered by the endorsement team hired by InGen to make sure Jurassic Park was safe for visitors. The entire team was astonished. Doctors Alan Grant and Ellie Sattler were the most awestruck of the group because the Brachiosaurus was terrestrial, not semi-aquatic swamp dwellers like they had thought they were.

When Mt. Sibo erupts, this individual, the same one seen by Grant and Sattler 25 years ago, made it to the island's northern dock and began desperately crying out and standing on her hind legs as she was slowly engulfed by the volcano's toxic smoke and debris, watched by an emotional Claire Dearing and Owen Grady in the Arcadia as it closes.
